bio: Located at one of the entrances to the glamorous Istinye Park shopping centre, Esca has a contemporary yet cosy feel – perfect for an intimate dinner for two! The lovely terrace beckons in fine weather. Osman Sezener expresses his passion for Mediterranean cuisine and local produce through an international menu. With options ranging from sushi and gyoza to house-made pasta and succulent lamb chops with a pistachio sauce, every palate is catered for. The tiramisu, with its beautiful balance between the bitterness of the coffee and the creaminess of the mascarpone, has already become a house favourite. Treat yourself to one of the signature cocktails.
